d: Vestibule of the theater in the palace of Burgundy. Cartel hanging with the announcement of the comedy: Scaramuccia Hermita.In front of the entrance to the audience; from the two sides practicable stairs that they put to the loggias. From one side door and guard body; from another a coffee shop. Lumiere lit. Some people sitting at the cafe, others coming from the theater, others going up and down walking the atrium. Odesi inside the orchestra that plays the symphony, or intermezzo, that is used between one act and the other.
Great show in the theater.
He comes out of the theatre Tomaso on the run, chased by many people. An officer with soldiers shows up from the guard body. Knights and Dames from the stairs of the loggia.
Domenico, then Lelio.
Scaramuccia in his costume, surrounded by all the troops of Comici, Men and Women in various clothes, with bundles, utensils for comedy etc. etc.
Domenico, Scaramuccia, then Tomaso.
Room in the house of Scaramuccia. Sandrina comes out followed by Comedants men and women.
Sandrina, turn on Scaramuccia.
Sandrina, then Tomaso.
Lelio, and sayings.
Lelius alone, lead the Continus.
The Continum alone.
Scaramuccia, and Contino.
Scaramuccia solo, indi Domenico, Lelio, and Commediante.
Sandrina, Tomaso, and sayings.
The Count, and sayings.

Gallery in the country house of the Contino di Pontigny. It is night, and the place is illuminated by rich doubles. Elena is sitting at a modestly dressed and melancholy table: two waiters are around her hair hair; some dancers of the work are distracting her with porle under the eye various ornaments.
The Continum followed by Friends invited to the feast, and said.
Scaramuccia, Lelio, Sandrina, and Comici, the Continent, and sayings.
Tomaso with a bundle, and sayings.
Room with seats. Theatre table with curtain down. Orchestra with Players. Invited to the party, Men and Women: others are sitting, others are walking among themselves.
The Continum by arm to Elena, then a Staffiere, and finally the Viscount of San Valier.
Scaramuccia, and sayings.
A Staffman carrying a letter, and sayings.
